tasks.label: TSC Check Frontend
tasks.command: cd d:\attomooh\webProject\frontend && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Out-File d:\attomooh\tsc.txt -Encoding utf8

tasks.label: Format Backend 2
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Push-Location 'd:\attomooh\webProject\backend\attomooh-back'; npm run format 2>&1 | Out-File -FilePath 'd:\attomooh\webProject\format-out2.txt' -Encoding utf8"

tasks.label: Delete Extra Files
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem 'd:\attomooh\webProject' -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.txt','.mjs','.cjs' -and $_.Name -ne 'abdulhamidhajhamad_db_user.txt' } | Remove-Item -Force; Write-Host 'DONE: Extra files deleted'; Get-ChildItem 'd:\attomooh\webProject' -File | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }"

tasks.label: Delete Extra 2
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$files = @('backend-tsc.txt','be-tsc-final.txt','cats-output.txt','fe-tsc-final.txt','fe-tsc.txt','fe-tsc2.txt','format-out.txt','format-out2.txt','format3.txt','frontend-tsc.txt','prettier-out.txt','tsc-out.txt','list-cats.mjs','list-cats2.mjs','migrate-parents.mjs','migrate-v2.mjs','migrate-v3.cjs','migrate-v4.cjs','update-icons.mjs'); foreach($f in $files){ $p = Join-Path 'd:\attomooh\webProject' $f; if(Test-Path $p){ Remove-Item $p -Force; Write-Host ('Deleted: ' + $f) } }; Write-Host 'DONE'; Get-ChildItem 'd:\attomooh\webProject' -File | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }"

tasks.label: Del Files CMD
tasks.command: del /F /Q d:\attomooh\webProject\backend-tsc.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\be-tsc-final.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\cats-output.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\fe-tsc-final.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\fe-tsc.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\fe-tsc2.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\format-out.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\format-out2.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\format3.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\frontend-tsc.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\prettier-out.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\tsc-out.txt d:\attomooh\webProject\list-cats.mjs d:\attomooh\webProject\list-cats2.mjs d:\attomooh\webProject\migrate-parents.mjs d:\attomooh\webProject\migrate-v2.mjs d:\attomooh\webProject\migrate-v3.cjs d:\attomooh\webProject\migrate-v4.cjs d:\attomooh\webProject\update-icons.mjs

tasks.label: Cleanup Files
tasks.command: Remove-Item 'd:\attomooh\webProject\*.txt' -Exclude 'abdulhamidhajhamad_db_user.txt' -Force; Remove-Item 'd:\attomooh\webProject\*.mjs' -Force; Remove-Item 'd:\attomooh\webProject\*.cjs' -Force; Get-ChildItem 'd:\attomooh\webProject' -File | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.Name }

tasks.label: Final Cleanup
tasks.command: Remove-Item 'd:\attomooh\webProject\frontend-tsc.txt' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item 'd:\attomooh\webProject\prettier-out.txt' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-ChildItem 'd:\attomooh\webProject' -File | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_.Name }

tasks.label: Force Delete Last
tasks.command: Stop-Process -Name node -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep 2; Remove-Item 'd:\attomooh\webProject\frontend-tsc.txt','d:\attomooh\webProject\prettier-out.txt' -Force; Get-ChildItem 'd:\attomooh\webProject' -File | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }
